messages:
elaine_sales: Hey team — Acme just accepted a 4‑week POC. Need quick alignment on hosting mode + success criteria so we can turn around the SOW. Goals: demonstrate 2 key flows, show cost baseline, and pass security checklist.

raj_se: Congrats! Quick Qs: will Acme send PII? region preference? expected concurrent users?

elaine_sales: They said: no customer PII in inputs, but some product IDs and internal notes. Region: EU preferred, but can accept US for initial test. Concurrent: ~20 steady, spikes to 100 during batch runs.

marco_sre: For that footprint we can do Hosted for speed, Dedicated for predictable perf, Private if they need VPC/KMS. Tradeoffs: Hosted = fastest onboarding (1–2 days), Dedicated = 1–2 weeks to reserve capacity, Private = 3–6+ weeks (network + infra).

elaine_sales: Good. We need SLO targets to propose. Sophia, any product level KPIs?

sophia_prod: Propose these success criteria: 1) Latency p95 < 350ms for single-turn generation; 2) End-to-end throughput 50 reqs/min with 100-token avg; 3) Quality: >= 85% pass rate on eval prompt set; 4) Cost estimate within target: <$0.015 per 1k tokens for inference (hosted baseline).

raj_se: For evals, can we use a small labeled set + synthetic edge prompts? I can assemble 200 prompts: 150 normal, 50 adversarial. Example prompts: ```Summarize the product note for non-technical stakeholders.``` and ```Given this error log, suggest next steps and likely root cause.```

marco_sre: Also add an operational success metric: no more than 2 production errors per 10k tokens during POC, and observability hooks enabled (token-level cost + trace ids).

elaine_sales: Security questionnaire: they require KMS integration + audit logs. security-bot: New security task created: ACME‑SQ‑117. Required items: KMS, SOC2 attestation, data residency (EU), key rotation policy.

marco_sre: If they insist on EU residency and KMS, Hosted can still work if we serve from eu-west-1 and enable customer-managed keys (we need legal ok). Dedicated/Gov/Private easier for strict residency and KMS integration.

raj_se: Pricing impact: Hosted (eu-west) estimate: $X/day based on token forecast (I will attach calc). Dedicated: one-time reservation + lower per-token. Private: license + infra ops. I'll draft numbers.

elaine_sales: Timeline proposal: Week 0: kickoff + security Q complete; Week 1: integration + eval dataset upload; Week 2: run evals + cost/latency tuning; Week 3: measure KPIs + final report. Total 4 weeks including buffer.

marco_sre: Action items: - raj_se: upload eval prompts + traffic profile by EOD Wed - sophia_prod: create the 85% pass rubric and attach examples - security-bot: confirm if Hosted eu-west with CMK satisfies ACME legal - me: prepare a Dedicated slot quote if they want guaranteed throughput

elaine_sales: Thanks — I'll update the SOW draft and propose Hosted eu-west as default, with Dedicated as fallback. /cc @raj_se @marco_sre @sophia_prod :thumbsup:

raj_se: Sounds good. I'll kick off the prompt set and a quick perf run on eu-west tomorrow.

sophia_prod: I'll share the rubric in the doc.

security-bot: ACME‑SQ‑117 status: pending customer clarification on key ownership. :thinking_face:
